````diff
+# Prompts
+
+<!-- DOMAIN-INTRO-START -->
+<!-- A short orientation for this page; task guidance belongs under Use. Kept across regeneration. -->
+<!-- DOMAIN-INTRO-END -->
+
+## Running a prompt
+
+A prompt is a template this server fills from the arguments listed with it and hands to your client as a message, so a task starts with the server's own instructions. It runs the same tools with the same access as anything you type. How to start one depends on the client:
+
+- **Claude Code** lists each prompt in the `/` menu as `/<server>:<prompt> (MCP)`, where `<server>` is the name you gave this server when you added it. Typing `/mcp__<server>__<prompt>` runs it too; arguments follow it separated by spaces, each a single token.
+- **claude.ai and Claude Desktop** offer a connector's prompts from the compose area's **+** menu once the connector is added.
+
+## `summarize`
+
+Summarize a passage in one paragraph.
+
+| Argument | Required | Description |
+|---|---|---|
+| `context` | yes | The passage. |
+
+<!-- DOMAIN-EXAMPLE-summarize-START -->
+<!-- A worked example for this prompt; kept across regeneration. -->
+<!-- DOMAIN-EXAMPLE-summarize-END -->
````

````diff
+# Resources
+
+<!-- DOMAIN-INTRO-START -->
+<!-- A short orientation for this page; task guidance belongs under Use. Kept across regeneration. -->
+<!-- DOMAIN-INTRO-END -->
+
+## Reading a resource
+
+A resource is data this server serves at a URI, for a client to attach to the conversation rather than for the model to call. In Claude Code, mention one as `@<server>:<uri>`, where `<server>` is the name you gave this server when you added it; a resource template takes its parameters in the URI.
+
+## `status`
+
+`status://markdown-vault-mcp` (text/plain)
+
+Current service status.
+
+## `_app_shell`
+
+`ui://markdown_vault_mcp/app.html` (text/html;profile=mcp-app)
````

````diff
+# Tools
+
+<!-- DOMAIN-INTRO-START -->
+<!-- A short orientation for this page; task guidance belongs under Use. Kept across regeneration. -->
+<!-- DOMAIN-INTRO-END -->
+
+Every tool runs with the server's own privileges; the [security model](../../security-model.md) says what that reaches.
+
+| Group | Tool | Title | Does |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Tools | [`ping`](tools.md#ping) | Ping | Check that the service is alive; returns `pong`. |
+| Server apps | [`get_status`](server_apps.md#get_status) | `get_status` | Return server status (app-only; hidden from the LLM). |
+| Server apps | [`get_info`](server_apps.md#get_info) | `get_info` | Return server info (app-only; hidden from the LLM). |
+| Server info | [`get_server_info`](server_info.md#get_server_info) | Server Info | Report the version information of markdown-vault-mcp; returns `server_name`, `server_version`, `core_version`, the MCP protocol revisions supported and the revision and client of this connection, and, when configured, the upstream service's version. |
````
